entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • DbContext.EnsureCreatedAsync takes ~12secs #36675
  • Allow IndexerProperty to allow index types other than string #36673

Closed

  • Unexpected Build Time Increase in .NET 9.0 When Using EF Core 9.0 Packages with Large Model Snapshots #36672
  • SYSTEM_VERSIONING = ON with a computed column causes an exception during migration in EF9 #35180
  • EF9: single transaction spanning all migrations causes transaction-incompatible SQL to fail #35096
    10.0.0
  • Debug view threw Unable to cast object of type 'Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.RuntimeNavigation' to type 'Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Infrastructure.AnnotatableBase' #35276
    10.0.0
  • Cosmos: Use ExecutionStrategy for query execution #35692
    10.0.0
  • By convention we generate ambiguous table name for some models with owned collections #35710
    10.0.0
  • Model change detected because of newlines across Windows/Unix #35382
    10.0.0
  • [M.D.Sqlite] Support for specifying offset when storing `byte[]`/`string` #36674
  • Scaffold does not generate Entity class for Table containing multiple FK and PK #35798
  • entry.CurrentValues.TryGetValue<object> throws System.InvalidCastException when accessing long property. #36661

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36676
  • [rc2] Fix SQLite migrations when replacing primary key with autoincrement identity #36670
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Fix null reference exception in migrations when string has invalid store type #36669
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Fix temporal table versioning when removing default constraints from columns #36667
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Fix AmbiguousMatchException when migration classes inherit DbContextAttribute #36666
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Fix concurrency issue in RelationalConnection ambient transaction handling #36665
    ask-mode

Merged

  • [rc2] Revert migrator behavior to use a transaction for each migration (when possible) #36662
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Fix InvalidCastException in ToDebugString when using IncludeAnnotations with RuntimeNavigation #36651
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Cosmos: Use ExecutionStrategy for query execution #36671
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Add a test for default owned collection mapping #36663
    tell-mode
  • [rc2] Ignore line endings when comparing strings in MigrationsModelDiffer #36664

Updated

  • [rc2] Handle escaping in JSON consistently by using JSON_VALUE with JSON_MODIFY #36653
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Fix transformation from JsonQueryExpression to OPENJSON #36642
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Implement ExecuteUpdate support for complex JSON #36659
    ask-mode
